data.content_ref: inline:The target's core move — claiming that preferring better-corroborated theories is 'not inductive' but rather 'recognizing an existing dispositional property' — is circular. To say a theory has an 'objective propensity to survive specific test conditions' is meaningless unless we can ascertain that propensity's value, and the only available evidence for it is the theory's observed track record of surviving past tests. Inferring a future-relevant dispositional property from past observations is precisely induction. The target relabels the inductive step as 'recognition' without supplying any non-inductive epistemic route to the propensity value, so it presupposes what it set out to replace.
